description:
Packages exact retailer products into links for the user to open.

The handoff repeats the products, links, and quantities with the original
request. It does not contact the retailer, change a cart, or check out.

items.description: Exact products, 1-50, each with the retailer's product_id, a name, an absolute HTTPS product_url, and a positive quantity.
Exact retailer product selected before a handoff or cart write.

original_request.description: The shopping request the products were chosen for.

store_id.description: Retailer store or location id, if known.

name: prepare_retailer_handoff
title: Prepare product links
